message.reasoning: Assess. Reasonable report, some depth, references, case studies. Weaknesses: no figures/tables, some OCR artifacts, arguments somewhat one-sided, stakeholder analysis limited, no discussion of "how to decide when to ship" beyond refusing, health contract addressed. Marks: C1: several issues, stakeholders identified, org context — Very good 8. C2: arguments both sides, conclusion, but depth moderate, stakeholder-specific recommendations limited — 8. C3: logical structure, conclusion supported — 8. C4: references + case studies, some quantitative (NHS) — 8. C5: fluent, no visuals, references okay — 6.
